title: Detached Cyndaquil promptly resumes follower motion

verification.actor: One prepared party Cyndaquil starts idle and mounted in follower slot 7. The same current handle becomes the unmounted Follower.
verification.trigger: Press SELECT once to detach, release SELECT by holding RIGHT, and move the player far enough to clear the follower's next tile.
verification.observable: The same Cyndaquil emits one Mounted-to-Follower ACTOR_REBOUND and one owned-to-autonomous CONTROL_REBOUND, then creates, accepts, renders, commits and finishes its first normal follower Walk no later than one completed frame after the player clears the follower's next tile.

setupMutations.change: Use private test.sav; teleport to map33 tile584/403; prepare party slot0 as species155 level10 HP1 status0; spawn that party subject mounted, settle16 frames, and bind its current identity. Do not change actor timers, cooldowns, profiles, targets, collision or motion during observation.

limits: Prepared party and mount setup do not prove natural acquisition or the mount selection UI.
The scenario proves only the first normal follower Walk after detach on this clear Route 29 fixture.
Copied-data controls reject a missing actor, either missing rebound receipt, and a follower held idle past the post-clearance resume bound.

events.value: Press SELECT once to detach the mounted Cyndaquil.
Release SELECT and hold RIGHT until the player moves one normal tile away.
Observe the same autonomous Follower complete its first normal Walk.

stop.condition: The first detached follower Walk has completed or the post-clearance resume bound has failed.

invariants: The mounted and follower views name the same current Cyndaquil handle and source object
Detached control is autonomous with no retained reservation
The first follower Walk starts no later than one completed frame after the player clears its next tile
The first follower Walk has contiguous rendered travel, one logical commit and one autonomous control return
